title: Two-column Settings on a phone; Enable notifications spaced and only when possible
goal: Settings keeps two columns at 390 px and the Enable button shows, with space around it, only when enabling can work
acceptance: At 390 px two columns, no horizontal scroll
Enable only when push is supported, permission not denied and this device not subscribed; subscribed shows Turn off; denied a short muted hint
privacy: Neutral invented machine and job names only.
escalation: A change to how a section looks goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: CSS media rule, a header class, the push view states and a test. Not a measurement.
